questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B) Sumatra, Java, bali, Lombok. • The correct sequence of the Islands of Indonesia from West to East is - Sumatra, Java, Bali and Lombok. • Indonesia's islands can be grouped into the Greater Sunda Islands of Sumatra (Sumatera), Java (Jawa), the southern extent of Borneo (Kalimantan), and Celebes (Sulawesi); the Lesser Sunda Islands (Nusa Tenggara) of Bali and a chain of islands that runs eastward through Timor; the Moluccas (Maluku) between Celebes and the island of New Guinea; and the western extent of New Guinea (generally known as Papua).
